title: F.E. Warren witnesses flagged as security risks
place_text: F.E. Warren Air Force Base, Wyoming

tellings.quote: in the spring of 2011 they were told on on each occasion uh during their exit interview from the air force that a flag was being put in their folders uh citing them as a security risk

plain: Witnesses at F.E. Warren Air Force Base in Wyoming were told, in their exit interviews from the Air Force in the spring of 2011, that a flag was being put in their files naming them as security risks. Robert Hastings, who collects accounts of UFOs at nuclear weapons bases, tells Michels this, passing on what he heard from a man named John Mills. If true, it would mean the Air Force marked people as risks for what they had seen.
